text:
# What I'd do with the page my friend sent

## 1. My answer

I'd open an account at **פסגות** and buy **"אי.בי.אי. מחקה (4A) ת"א 125"**. The number next to it is 5112628.

The page puts it at the top with **"הבחירה שלכם · ★ הזול"** and says I'd end up with **86,045 ₪** after 10 years. I'd put in 70,000 ₪ in total. The page added 10,000 ₪ up front on its own, plus 500 ₪ a month. If I don't have 10,000 ₪ now I'd have to change that box, and I only have the screenshots, so I can't see the new number.

**How sure: fairly sure about פסגות, less sure about the fund.**
- **פסגות:** the gap between banks is big. **אלטשולר טרייד** leaves me 65,812 ₪, which is 20,000 ₪ less. That's easy to understand.
- **The fund:** the next one, **תכלית סל**, is only **"‎−1,030 ₪"** behind. I don't know what "מחקה" or "סל" means, so I'm going on the star.
- **The 7% is made up.** The bottom says **"תשואה לדוגמה, לא תחזית"**, so 86,045 is a "maybe", not a promise.

## 2. What I actually used

- The top: the title **"איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד, לאורך זמן"**, the index buttons (**ת"א-125** was already picked) and the boxes **סכום היום / הפקדה חודשית / תשואה בשנה**.
- The result card: **"הפקדתם 70,000 ₪"**, **"הבחירה שלכם · ★ הזול 86,045 ₪"** and **"הזוג הבא בתור 85,015 ₪"**.
- The bank list under **"חשבון ניירות ערך"** (פסגות, לאומי, וואן זירו…). I only looked at the big number on each row.
- The fund list **"כל הקרנות על מדד ת"א-125"**, mainly to check that the starred fund was first.

## 3. Block by block

| Block | What I did | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Title and short explanation | Used | It told me what the page is for: pick an account and a fund, see what's left. |
| **"המדד"** buttons | Used | ת"א-125 was already picked. **"האתר לא ממליץ על מדד"** was fine. |
| **"מדד ת"א-125 · ישראלי"** description | Skimmed | It confirmed it's the 125 biggest companies. **"תקרה למניה אחת"** and **"אין קרן חוץ שמתמחה בישראל"** went over my head. |
| Sliders (amount, monthly, yearly %) | Used, with a doubt | Was 10,000 ₪ "today" something I'm supposed to have? |
| **"אינפלציה"** button / **"לדוגמה של האתר · בכסף של היום"** | Confused | Is it on or off? What does "בכסף של היום" do to my number? |
| Result card (70,000 → 86,045) | Used | The most useful part of the page. |
| **"כמה זה עולה לכם ב־10 שנים"** coloured bar (7,323 ₪) | Skimmed, confused | The biggest piece, 5,555, is pink, which is **מס**. Tax counts as a "cost"? I thought costs were the bank's fees. |
| **"העלות אצלכם, לעומת הזוג השני"** (החשבון 18 ₪ יותר, הקרן 1,390 ₪ פחות, המס 342 ₪ יותר) | Skipped after trying | Paying more tax was supposedly good (**"כי נשאר לכם יותר רווח"**). My head hurt. |
| **"פסגות ניירות ערך בע"מ"** card (1,049 ₪ in 10 years) | Used a bit | Good to know the account itself costs about 1,000 ₪ over 10 years. |
| Bank ranking list | Used | I read the names and the big numbers. |
| **"לא בחישוב · מחיר אחר לצעירים…"** tags | Read, worried | I'm 24. Am I a **"צעיר"**? Could לאומי beat פסגות for me? See question 6. |
| **אינטראקטיב ישראל / Interactive Brokers – "אין נתון"** | Skimmed | Fine, I just ignored them. |
| Fund card (**"דמי ניהול: 0.1% קבועים 0% משתנים, נאמן 0.025%"**, **"קרן מחקה"**) | Confused | Too many percentages. I don't know what נאמן is. |
| Fund list (**"מול הבסיס"**, ‎−0.04%, ‎−1,030 ₪…) | Skimmed | I saw the chosen fund at the top and the others losing ₪. The % column made no sense to me. |
| The explanation under the fund list (**"מול המדד: כמה הקרן הקדימה (+) או פיגרה (−)…"**) | Skipped | Too long and technical. |
| **"מה הכי משנה את מה שיישאר לכם"** chart and table | Skimmed, one useful idea | Staying **12 years instead of 10** gives **"18,905 ₪ יותר"**. Nice, but it doesn't help me choose. |
| **"מתחילים מבחירה אחת, ורואים מה משפר אותה ובכמה"** (step chart) | Confused | Why start from **"הראל סל (4A) ת"א 125, ירושלים"**? I never picked that. It ends at the same 86,045 anyway. |
| **"עכשיו: הראל סל… נשארים בסוף 79,910 ₪"** and the green/red tables | Skimmed | It's the same ranking again with different numbers. That made me less sure which number is "the real one". |
| Fine print at the bottom | Skimmed | I noted **"תשואה לדוגמה, לא תחזית"** and **"נתונים נכון ל־05.11.2026"** (yesterday, good). |
| Footer (**"אתר אישי, לא מסחרי, בלי קישורי שיווק"**) | Read | It made me trust it a bit more. |

## 4. In the lists, tables and charts

- **Bank list:**
  - **Looked at:** the rank number (1, 2, 3…), the bank name, the big **"נשאר"** number and the **"★ הזול"** label.
  - **Glanced at:** the smaller number under it (1,049 / 4,506…). I guessed it's what the bank takes.
  - **Ignored:** the coloured bars (orange/yellow/red/grey). I didn't go back up to the colour key, so they meant nothing to me.
  - **Read but didn't understand:** **"מחיר להוראת קבע"**.
- **Fund list:**
  - **Looked at:** the fund names and the **‎−1,030 / −1,113 / −1,154 / −1,733 ₪** column.
  - **Ignored:** the code numbers and the **‎−0.04% / −0.37%** with **"בשנה · שנה אחת"**.
  - **Didn't understand:** the tags **"קרן מחקה"**, **"קרן סל"**, **"מחזיקה את המניות"**, **"כמה דרכים יחד"** and the column header **"מול הבסיס"**.
- **"מה הכי משנה" chart:**
  - **Looked at:** the yellow **"שנים"** line, because it's the steepest, and the right-hand column of the table, **"ההפרש"**.
  - **Ignored:** the buttons (‎20% פחות … 50% יותר) and the dashed and solid vertical lines.
- **Step chart:**
  - **Looked at:** **"עכשיו"**, **79,910 ₪**, **+5,022 ₪** for פסגות and **+1,113 ₪**.
  - **Ignored:** the zig-zag at the bottom of the bar, the dotted line, the 60K/70K/80K axis and the legend (**"הצעד הכי גדול שנשאר, עוד לא נלקח"** and the lock icon **"נשען על כלל מס פתוח: מוצג ולא מדורג"**).
- **The dotted purple underlines** on every number: I didn't know if they're tappable or what they'd show.

## 5. What I didn't understand

- **"חשבון ניירות ערך"**: is it like a bank account? Do I need to move my salary there?
- **"קרן מחקה"** vs **"קרן סל"**, and what **"(4A)"** means.
- **"דמי ניהול קבועים / משתנים"**, **"נאמן"** and **"העמלות זו על זו"**.
- **"עמלות קנייה ומכירה"** vs **"דמי משמרת"**.
- **"מול הבסיס"**, and why there's a minus % for the fund I'm told to pick.
- **"בכסף של היום"** and what the **"אינפלציה"** button does.
- Why tax is shown as a cost, and why paying more tax is good.
- What **"הזוג"** means. I only figured out late that it's a bank plus a fund.
- Why the step chart's starting point is הראל סל at ירושלים.
- **"נשען על כלל מס פתוח"**.

## 6. What I wanted to know and couldn't find

- **Am I a "צעיר" for לאומי or מזרחי?** What's that price, and would it beat פסגות? The page says **"לא בחישוב"** and stops there.
- **How to actually do it:** open a פסגות account (app? branch? how long?), set up the 500 ₪ a month, and type the fund number in to buy it.
- **What if I only do monthly**, with no 10,000 ₪ at the start? (The screenshots can't show me.)
- **Is פסגות safe?** What happens to my money if they close?
- **Can I take money out early**, and what does that cost?
- **Is 7% a normal year for ת"א-125?** A past number would help me trust it.

## 7. If half the page had to go, I'd cut these first

1. The step chart **"מתחילים מבחירה אחת…"** and both tables under it (green/red bars, "סוג קרן אחר", "קרן אחרת מאותו סוג"). It repeats the ranking from a starting point I never chose, with new numbers that confused me.
2. The **"מה הכי משנה"** chart. I'd keep one sentence: "staying 2 more years = about 19,000 ₪ more".
3. **"העלות אצלכם, לעומת הזוג השני"** (18 ₪ / 1,390 ₪ / 342 ₪).
4. The fund detail card (management fee %, נאמן) and the long **"מול המדד"** explanation.

**I'd keep:** the inputs at the top, the **86,045 ₪** result card, the bank list with the "young people" notes, and the fund list.
